test_title: PYST 71: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In October 2025, the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) published the PM2.5 air quality assessment of Indian cities. What does PM2.5 refer to?

options.text: Sulphur dioxide emissions released from industrial units
Ground-level ozone produced during photochemical reactions
Fine particulate matter with a diameter of 2.5 micrometres or smaller
Carbon monoxide generated from incomplete combustion

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fine particulate matter with a diameter of 2.5 micrometres or smaller**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM2.5** refers to **particulate matter** that consists of fine particles or droplets in the air that are **2.5 micrometres** or less in width.
 
• These particles are extremely tiny; for perspective, the average **human hair** is about **70 micrometres** in diameter, making **PM2.5** approximately **30 times smaller** than the width of a hair.
 
• In **October 2025**, the **Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA)** assessment highlighted the levels of these pollutants across **Indian cities**, focusing on the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** targets.
 
• Because of their microscopic size, these particles can bypass the nose and throat to reach deep into the **alveoli** of the **lungs** and even enter the **circulatory system**.
